The '''Earl of Vis''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] individual associated with<ref name="Inside" /> the [[City/Legends|city]] of<ref name="GB">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]''</ref> [[Vis/Legends|Vis]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. A historical figure of the planet, they were the cousin of one of its ancient [[Monarch of Naboo/Legends|kings]].<ref name="Encyclopedia">{{CSWECite|I|224|Earl of Vis}}</ref> The [[Earl/Legends|earl]] built a large [[Banqueting rotunda/Legends|banquet rotunda]] in [[Theed/Legends|Theed]], the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of Naboo,<ref name="Inside" /> and owned a [[Earl of Vis' castle|castle]] in the planet's [[Western Reaches (Naboo)|Western Reaches]]. They were also the ancestor of [[Ars Veruna/Legends|Ars Veruna]], a [[King/Legends|king]] of Naboo who resided in the earl's castle after abdicating<ref name="Plagueis">[[Darth Plagueis (novel)|''Darth Plagueis'']]</ref> in [[33 BBY/Legends|33 BBY]].<ref name="Deception">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' places the events of ''[[Cloak of Deception]]'', which depicts [[Monarch of Naboo/Legends|King]] [[Ars Veruna/Legends|Veruna's]] abdication, in [[33 BBY/Legends|33 BBY]].</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Earl of Vis was first mentioned in the [[2000]] reference book ''[[Inside the Worlds of Star Wars: Episode I]]'', written by [[Kristin Lund]]. Set during [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Queen Amidala's]] reign, the book established that the earl was cousin to "the old king," implying a family connection with King Veruna, the ruler who preceeded Amidala.<ref name="Inside" /> The [[Databank (original)|Databank]] entry for [[Theed Royal Palace/Legends|Theed Royal Palace]] also repeated that statement.<ref name="Databank">{{DB|location|theedroyalpalace|Theed Royal Palace}}</ref> However, the [[2008]] reference book ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> and [[James Luceno]]'s [[2012]] novel [[Darth Plagueis (novel)|''Darth Plagueis'']] established that the earl was cousin to an ancient king, with the latter specifying that the earl was an ancestor of Veruna.<ref name="Plagueis" />
